purpose: Surgical fix of A_FR_v3's two confirmed QA findings: segment 6 malformed franglais pronunciation, and English-dialogue leakage/duplication in the tail. No other segments regenerated.

changes_from_v3.note: Segment 6 was never a lip-sync segment (lipsync_segment_ids = {2,7,14,20,21}), so no lip-sync regeneration was needed for the repair.

segment_6_repair.reason: Existing 'Et après, ils te ghostent.' audio was independently confirmed malformed: two separate STT passes (plain, and with an explicit 'ghostent'/'ghost' keyterm hint) both failed to recognize it as French, with low model confidence on the words surrounding 'ghost' both times -- a sign of acoustic ambiguity in the audio itself, not just an unrecognized loanword.
segment_6_repair.new_text: Et après, ils ne te répondent plus.
segment_6_repair.meaning_preserved: Same meaning (being ignored/unresponsive after cash-out) without the problematic franglais verb conjugation. No product, monetary, performance, or promotional claim changed.
segment_6_repair.provider: ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech, same voice_id (rlqCQzyNTVyUMPGBqC31), same model (eleven_multilingual_v2), same voice_settings, no time compression -- identical configuration to the rest of A_FR_v3/the approved natural-voice test.
segment_6_repair.verification: Post-generation STT on the isolated new audio transcribed it back EXACTLY as 'Et après, ils ne te répondent plus' with every word at ~0 logprob (very high confidence) -- confirmed clean before use.
segment_6_repair.video_handling: Segment video rebuilt via the same loop-real-motion method as the rest of the build (no freeze-hold needed; 2.18s exceeds the 1.9s original span by 0.28s, well within a single loop cycle).

tail_fix.reason: Confirmed in A_FR_v3 QA: 'All right, I'm getting it' spoken in English at ~0.38-1.74s into the untranslated tail (original final/A_EN.mp4 50.1-57.4547s), duplicating segment 22's correct French line immediately before it.
tail_fix.method: Audio-only fix, no new generation call: applied ffmpeg volume=0 gated to enable='between(t,0.3,1.85)' on the tail's audio track only. Video track (including the branded FREECASH end-card, confirmed present via frame inspection at ~53.5s) is completely untouched. Ambience/music outside the muted window is preserved (~-29.5dB, consistent with the rest of the tail) -- only the specific English-speech window was silenced (~-67dB, i.e. silence/noise-floor).
tail_fix.end_card_content: FREECASH branded end-card: logo, 'Get paid for playing', '$10 Sign Up Boost Unlocked', 'Get Cash now' CTA button, App Store/Google Play badges -- all pre-existing baked-in graphic/UI content from the original source video, not altered, not translated (out of scope for this surgical fix; badges/UI graphics were not part of the spoken-dialogue leakage issue).

final_assembly.method: ffmpeg concat of the 23 segment clips (22 reused + repaired segment 6) followed by the muted tail, all already-normalized to matching codec/format so concat is a clean stream copy of consistent encodes.

localization_qa_automated_fresh_full_stt.method: Full-file STT (Scribe v2, word timestamps) run on the ENTIRE assembled A_FR_v4.mp4, same as the pass that originally caught the v3 defects -- not just per-segment spot checks.

monetary_check.detail: 'quarante-trois dollars' (43) confirmed again in the fresh full-video transcript.

segment_6_check.detail: Transcript now reads 'Et après, ils ne te répondent plus.' cleanly in context, matching the intended repaired text exactly.

english_leakage_check.detail: Keyword-stopword scan across all 209 recognized words in the fresh transcript found zero English hits (previously 3+ before the fix, including the full 'All right, I'm getting it' sentence). The only non-French token at the very end is a bracketed '[bruit de notification]' audio-event tag from the end-card's UI sound effect -- not speech, expected and left as-is.

duplicated_dialogue_check.detail: Segment 22 ('C'est bon, je la télécharge') now transitions directly into the (non-speech) end-card notification sound, with no trailing English restatement.

localization_qa_automated_fresh_full_stt.caption_language_check: All 23 burned captions confirmed French; segment 6's caption updated to match the repaired wording exactly. No English captions anywhere, including the end-card tail (which was never captioned by this pipeline, and its own baked-in text is pre-existing brand/UI graphic content, not a caption this pipeline added).

lipsync_integrity.detail: All 5 lip-sync outputs (segments 2,7,14,20,21) reused byte-for-byte from A_FR_v3 -- not touched by this repair, since segment 6 was never in the lip-sync set.

perceptual_quality.note: Segment 6's new pronunciation and the tail mute's audio transition (any abruptness at the mute boundary) are not auto-approved -- human listen still required, though all automated/technical gates you specified now pass.
